abstract: The effect of human granulocyte colony stimulating factor (hG-CSF) was investigated on the proliferation of choriocarcinoma cells in vitro. No growth-stimulating effect was observed. Then, 22 patients with invasive mole and 9 patients with choriocarcinoma who received combination chemotherapy were treated with hG-CSF when white blood cell counts decreased below 2,000/mm3. The duration of neutropenia was reduced significantly by 3-4 days with the use of hG-CSF. No side effects were observed. These results indicate safety and usefulness of hG-CSF as an adjunct to chemotherapy in the treatment of gestational trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌細胞に対するヒト顆粒球コロニー刺激因子(hG-CSF)の作用をin vitroで検討したところ、増殖促進作用は認められなかった。次に、併用化学療法を受けた侵入奇胎の患者22例と絨毛癌の患者9例に対し、白血球数が2,000/mm3未満に低下した時点でhG-CSFを投与した。好中球減少の期間は有意に3～4日短縮した。副作用は認められなかった。これらの結果は、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療における化学療法の補助として、hG-CSFの安全性と有用性を示すものである。
